original_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production pixel-art atlas for Dystrail, exactly 1536x1024, four equal 768x512 landscape cells in a 2x2 grid, no gutters, no border, no labels. Deliberately chunky hand-placed pixel clusters, limited palette, crisp stepped silhouettes, 1990s adventure-game background art; NO photorealism, painterly detail, smooth vector shapes or realistic texture.

All four cells share a carefully identical road layout: upper 55% shows a roadside checkpoint booth/counter and its people around x=390 in local cell coordinates. Lower 45% shows a wide EMPTY horizontal asphalt lane running left to right; a clearly visible unpaved branch peels down toward the lower-left corner. Leave the entire bottom roadway EMPTY for separately composited crew van, no vehicles, no travelers baked in. A narrow vertical barrier support at x=420 behind the road but NO horizontal barrier arm (added by game). Counters and people are fully visible above y=300; do not crop heads. Neutral daylight, unbranded rural US roadside trees and rolling grass, no identifiable monuments.

Top left: a middle-aged Black feminine crossing supervisor behind a roadside counter displaying a large blank laminated white sheet visibly fastened to counter by four large bolts. Their hand gestures toward the bolts. No jewelry. Sheet angled enough that four bolts read at small size.
Top right: two tired feminine workers, one dark-skinned and one East Asian, both physically holding a huge raised blank rectangular gate nameplate ABOVE their heads, using two hands each. The large blank nameplate is disproportionate, heavy looking, but no danger/injury. Do not add a horizontal traffic barrier across the empty road; these workers hold the raised overhead gate assembly.
Bottom left: an adult Latina woman in ordinary clothes asks a gender-neutral Black guard about two separate plain surveillance cameras mounted above their small roadside booth. Guard points to the SECOND camera. No uniforms with insignia, blank screens, no license plates or identifiable data.
Bottom right: an older South Asian feminine official in a tiny roadside booth wears a bent paper crown catching the low ceiling. A wooden coffee stirrer and small electric kettle sit on the counter. Crown is simple folded paper zigzags WITHOUT cross or emblem.

Absolute prohibition throughout: NO religious symbols of any kind, crosses, stars, devotional ornaments, necklaces, earrings, religious architecture, flags, logos, emblems, text, letters, numbers, money exchange, weapons, additional humans, vehicles, UI, gradients. Written surfaces entirely blank. Exactly 4 cells, each scene distinct as specified, consistent crisp pixel-art style.
edits: Coarse pixel clusters; flat bolted laminate; wider dirt branch.
Lower interior booth plank and crown visibly caught against it.
status: Integrated A setting, outcome render review in progress; B/C and localization unfinished.
